native_contract: The actual uv_loop, command admission and callbacks remain on the service worker. No raw loop, Engine pointer or guest callback is exported to the worker.
One Hub resource owns the shared service/FIFO/stop/join. Domain controllers hold independent service entitlements and attach after fallible staging.

Native uv_fs_t storage is allocated before original ReqWrap constructor/init hooks. Actual nonnegative admission acquires a flight/list/counter entitlement and promises one completion; immediate negative admission promises none.
Cancellation calls uv_cancel only for accepted, still-pending work. Rejected/unsubmitted/completed requests return an ordinary no-in-flight status.
Request cleanup is explicit and idempotent. Native path/backing survive callback/event delivery until cleanup. OPEN's successful descriptor remains an independent consumer resource.

The real Environment must disable JavaScript before shared stop/drain and retain Environment/VM through actual completion and request retirement. Root owns phased native-immediate/lifecycle composition.
exclusions: No native build, runtime, Node, generator or formatter execution.
No public FS/FileHandle or TCP namespace qualification.
The private Read binding, FSReqPromise, AfterScope, FS completion Controller and their lifecycle controls are not included in this first intake.
The new nonthrowing ArrayBufferView length API is a separate VM prerequisite for private Read and is not needed by this raw transport target.
No change to the original TCP12 root, admitted libuv sources or common network build helper.
